slo_title: Describe multilevel feedback queue scheduling algorithm

mcq.q: What is the main drawback of fixed priority scheduling in Multilevel Queue Scheduling?
Which of the following is true about Multilevel Queue Scheduling ?

options.A: All queues use the same scheduling algorithm
options.B: Only one queue is created for all processes
options.C: Each queue can use a different scheduling algorithm
options.D: Processes can move between queues dynamically

mcq.answer_text: Each queue can use a different scheduling algorithm
